descriptions.w3d_d29b_water_light_800919d4: Water light tables: normalizes the sun vector +260; unless the tint bytes +2484 are all above 254, finds or creates (0x8020b680) the prototype's shared 256-entry colour table and locks it, else publishes +368 and the plain colours; for each of the 256 normals at 0x80431ea0 stores the raised normal's light at +388, its own light at +392 unless byte +450 is set, and the tinted 4-4-4-4 colour for a new table; adds 512 to 0x804aab84.
